submitted.rationale: Measured EQE along the Pb–Sb–O line: 0.043% at Sb 0.28, 0.073% at 0.353, 0.055% at 0.383, 0.018% at 0.513 and 0.0005% at 0.659. EQE peaks on the Pb-rich side of Pb2Sb2O7 (predicted gap about 2.5 eV, below the 2.7 eV photon energy). Index 3 (Sb 0.353) gave the highest measured EQE.

rejected.reason: Near PbSb2O6 (predicted gap about 2.7 eV, at the photon energy); EQE was almost zero.
At the Pb2Sb2O7 composition, but EQE was 4x lower than index 3.
Where the fitted peak was predicted, but EQE was 0.055%, below index 3.
EQE dropped steadily as Sb increased, so this end was not explored.
